text.original: Floor: The lower surface in a storey on which one normally walks in a building. The general term, floor, unless otherwise specifically mentioned, shall not refer to a mezzanine floor. Note: The sequential numbering of floor shall be determined by its relation to the determin-ing entrance level. For floors at or wholly above ground level the lowest floor in the building with direct entrance from the road/street shall be termed as Ground floor, the other floors above ground Floor shall be numbered in sequence as Floor 1, Floor 2, etc. with number increasing upwards.
